## 3. The population: what was counted

Defendants' Exhibit 5 is 33 pages holding 111 slips: one surveyor's receipt (p. 1) and 110 receipts issued by Cesar's side. The full ledger is Appendix A; the CSV is in the research folder.

| Measure | Figure | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Receipts to the collector, total | 110 slips, ₱602,750 | Oct 2003 to Feb 2017 |
| Before the revocation (to 15 Aug 2005) | ₱38,100 | Includes the only "Down payment," ₱20,000 on 6 Jan 2005 (p. 3) |
| Revocation to deed (16 Aug 2005 to 29 Sep 2016) | ₱345,650 | Eleven years of collections by a revoked agent's son |
| After the deed (30 Sep 2016 to Feb 2017) | ₱219,000 | Nine slips; the price recited as already paid |
| Slips of ₱2,000 or less | 89 slips, ₱169,500 | Monthly pattern 2005 to 2014 |
| Estate-form receipts naming the month paid for | 15 slips, ₱27,000 | "Payment for the month of: March 2007," etc. (pp. 9 to 11, 23 to 27) |
| Receipted from 17 Nov 2014 onward | ₱382,650 | Exceeds the price by ₱132,650 |
| Receipted in 2016 to 2017 | ₱332,650 | Exceeds the price by ₱82,650 |
| Printed estate receipts (form E) | 43 slips | Serials 0019 to 0228 from a book printed in 1998 (ATP 451-1998) |
| Generic pads (forms G1 to G4) | 67 slips | Unnumbered; four different stationery designs |
| Signed "Von dela Fuente" in writing | 4 slips (2003 to 2005) | All others carry the stylized "S. dela Fuente" signature |
